title: Moore–Penrose left inverse: continuous on injective maps, with projection bound
statement: For all n, P there is a map Λ : L(ℝⁿ, ℝ^P) → L(ℝ^P, ℝⁿ), continuous on the set of injective linear maps, such that for every injective A ∈ L(ℝⁿ, ℝ^P): Λ(A)∘A = id_{ℝⁿ} and |A(Λ(A)v)| ≤ |v| for every v ∈ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (n P : ℕ), ∃ Λ : (Eucl n →L[ℝ] Eucl P) → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl n), ContinuousOn Λ {A : Eucl n →L[ℝ] Eucl P | Function.Injective A} ∧ ∀ A : Eucl n →L[ℝ] Eucl P, Function.Injective A → (Λ A).comp A = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Eucl n) ∧ ∀ v : Eucl P, ‖A (Λ A v)‖ ≤ ‖v‖
